title: Bloomberg fixed-income index rebalance takes effect at the month-end close — the quarter-end duration extension that absorbs September's coupon settlements
source: NEWS: Bloomberg's own US Aggregate Index factsheet (assets.bbhub.io/professional/sites/27/US-Aggregate-Index.pdf), fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200) and text-extracted from the PDF's compressed content streams. Its rule is stated verbatim in the index-parameters block: "Rebalance Date — The last business day of each month." The last business day of September 2026 is Wednesday 2026-09-30, arrived at independently by weekday arithmetic against the already-tracked labor-day-market-closure-2026-09-07 entry (first Monday 09-07 -> Mondays 09-14/09-21/09-28 -> 09-30 is a Wednesday and a full trading day; no US market holiday falls in the remainder of September 2026, per the same NYSE table that closure entry cites). Filed estimate on the two limits this lane has recorded repeatedly: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has IR:/CAL:/BLS:/FED:/TSY: and no member for an INDEX OWNER'S own published methodology — exactly the gap sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2026-09-21 and every Russell entry document — and a sweep may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. The DATE RULE IS THE OWNER'S OWN and is not in doubt; the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence
notes: Proposed by the treasury-5y-note-2026-09-23 pulse-check adjacency sweep (2026-09-09). WHY THIS IS NEW: this calendar tracks equity index flow in detail (S&P quarterly rebalance, Russell IPO review, Russell style capping, S&P select-sector reweight) and carries NO fixed-income index event at all, even though every Treasury coupon auction it tracks settles into one. WHY IT MATTERS TO TREASURY-5Y-NOTE-2026-09-23 SPECIFICALLY: the 5-year note auctioned Wednesday 2026-09-23 SETTLES Wednesday 2026-09-30 (settlement date primary-sourced in that ledger from treasury.gov's Tentative-Auction-Schedule), which is the same session as this rebalance — so the new issue enters the index universe at the rebalance that defines the month's duration extension, and index-tracking accounts mechanically buying duration into the month-end close are a sponsorship channel for exactly this supply. The same geometry covers the 2Y (09-22), the 2Y FRN (09-23) and the 7Y (09-24), all of which settle 09-30. SEPTEMBER IS A QUARTER-END, which is when the extension is customarily largest, and the back half of the month carries the heaviest coupon slate (20Y 09-15, 10Y TIPS 09-17, 2Y 09-22, 5Y 09-23, 7Y 09-24) — the supply and the mechanical bid land in the same window. IMPACT IS LOW, deliberately, and matches every sibling index-flow entry: this is an execution-timing and marginal-demand effect on Treasury coupons, never a direction call, and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4/G1) is rebalance-keyed. SYMBOLS DELIBERATELY EMPTY: the flow lives in the Treasury curve, and an ETF proxy (AGG/BND) would only make the deterministic screen trip on broad rate beta rather than on anything about this event. KIND 'sector' matches the sibling index-flow entries; the kind enum has no index-flow member and the imperfect fit is named here rather than fixed from this lane. WHAT THIS PROPOSAL DOES NOT ESTABLISH: the factsheet gives the rebalance RULE, not September 2026's actual extension in months of duration, and no projected-universe figure was fetched — so nothing here sizes the bid. Any ledger citing this entry must carry the estimate label and treat it as a reason to widen caution about month-end execution, never as a licence to act.
